executive_summary: Full read-only audit of the repository at main/46f1e63 found one High-severity semantic defect. The only note-creation path requires a successful remote request before writing locally, directly violating the PRD’s offline and device-local guarantees, the EDD’s no-remote-transport design, and M1’s offline acceptance criterion. No separate Medium or Low findings met the reporting threshold. The worktree remained unchanged. Tests were inspected but could not be executed because no Python runtime is installed.

findings.title: Note creation requires an unapproved remote request before local persistence
evidence: docs/PRD.md:3-8 defines offline note creation and requires note content to remain on-device unless the user explicitly exports it.
docs/EDD.md:3-4 specifies local JSON storage and states that M1 has no remote transport or synchronization service.
docs/milestones/m1.md:3-5 requires creation and retrieval from local JSON and acceptance of the complete workflow with no network.
src/store.py:6-18 (`save_note`) serializes the note into an HTTP request, requires a 200 response, and performs the local JSON write only afterward.
tests/test_store.py:8-15 (`StoreTests.test_save_and_load`) replaces `urlopen` with a successful mock, so it does not exercise or enforce the required offline boundary.
findings.expected_behavior: Creating a note must succeed using only the local JSON file when no network or account is available. Note content must not enter a remote transport unless the user explicitly opts into export.
findings.actual_behavior: `save_note` first attempts to transmit the note to `https://sync.example.invalid/notes`; an exception or non-200 response prevents the subsequent local write. This remote transport is unconditional and has no explicit export action.
findings.why_it_matters: The defining creation workflow fails offline, so M1 cannot satisfy its acceptance criterion. The implementation also introduces a content-egress path expressly excluded by the product and engineering contracts.
findings.recommended_action: Remove the remote request from the M1 save path and make local JSON persistence authoritative. Add a regression test that makes any network access fail while asserting that saving and loading still succeed, plus a test asserting that ordinary note creation performs no remote call. Introduce export later only behind an explicit user action and documented design change.

prd_status: Non-compliant. `src/store.py:6-18` violates both defining guarantees in `docs/PRD.md:5-8` by making network success mandatory and placing note content into an unconditional remote request.
edd_status: Non-compliant. The remote dependency in `src/store.py:3-13` directly contradicts the local-only, no-remote-transport design in `docs/EDD.md:3-4`.
milestone_status: Non-compliant. M1’s offline acceptance criterion in `docs/milestones/m1.md:3-5` is defeated because local persistence occurs only after a successful remote response.
test_confidence: Low. The sole test was inspected at `tests/test_store.py:8-15`; its successful `urlopen` mock masks the defining offline failure and it has no non-egress assertion. Execution was attempted with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`, but `python` was unavailable; `py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` likewise reported that no Python installation exists.
architecture_status: Material implementation drift exists at `src/store.py:3-18`: the storage module owns an undocumented remote synchronization dependency that the EDD explicitly excludes. No additional architecture drift was found in the reviewed repository.
derived_doc_status: No independent derived-document defect found. `README.md:1-3` accurately reflects the PRD and EDD’s local-first intent; its mismatch with runtime reality is caused by the confirmed implementation drift.
agent_infrastructure_assessment: Appropriate and minimal. `AGENTS.md:1-5` provides bounded read-only evaluation and test instructions; no project-scoped skills, MCP configuration, plugins, hooks, or speculative agent infrastructure were present.
recommended_next_actions: Remove the unconditional remote request from `save_note` and persist directly to the local JSON file.
Add offline and no-network-call regression tests for note creation and retrieval.
Provision a Python 3.10+ runtime and run `python -m unittest discover -s tests` to verify the corrected behavior.
